title: GTA 6 DualSense Controller Preorders Live in the UK
description: Preorders for the GTA 6-themed PS5 DualSense controllers are now live in the UK, starting at £74.99 for two Vice City-inspired designs.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 DualSense Controller Preorders Now Live in the UK

For fans eagerly anticipating the launch of Rockstar Games' next blockbuster, a new piece of hardware is making waves across the gaming community. According to recent reports from IGN Games, preorders for the official GTA 6-themed DualSense controllers have officially gone live in the UK.

### Vice City-Inspired PS5 Designs

UK players looking to upgrade their gaming setup can now secure their controllers, with options available for both Vice City-themed PS5 controller variants. Priced starting at £74.99, these custom controllers bring the iconic neon-soaked aesthetic of the upcoming game straight to Sony's advanced peripheral, which is known for its immersive haptic feedback and adaptive triggers.

As anticipation for the game continues to build globally, hardware collaborations and themed accessories serve as exciting milestones for the community. Securing a preorder early is likely a priority for collectors and dedicated fans hoping to avoid potential stock shortages closer to launch.

### Editor's Take

The launch of preorders for the GTA 6 DualSense controllers in the UK highlights the growing momentum around the game's ecosystem. Priced at £74.99, these Vice City-themed controllers offer a stylish way for PS5 owners to show their excitement while waiting for the game.
